title: Maryland Phoebe Davis
repository: Delaware Native American Archives / Mitsawokett Collection
transcriber: Archival Transcriber / Written in the Genome
citation: "Maryland Phoebe Davis." Historical Document Record (2020). Preserved in the Nanticoke & Moor Historical Archive (Written in the Genome Collection).
lines: Order of service and obituary, funeral program of Maryland Phoebe Davis (Watson Funeral Home, February 1, 2020). Obituary: born in Millsboro, Delaware on June 30, 1939 to the late William Wesley Davis and Phoebe (Thompson) Davis; preceded in death by her companion of 37 years Charles Henry; educated at Millsboro #204 School and William C. Jason High School; employed at Townsend Poultry Plant for over 30 years; helped raise her sister Joan's children Sandra Davis, Jane Davis, and Toney Floyd. Interment: Harmony U.M. Cemetery, 28571 Harmony Cemetery Rd, Millsboro, DE 19966. The small photograph beside the obituary shows her with an unidentified man (the couch photograph; the man is not Charles Henry, per Jequan Davis's ruling of 2026-11-23). Program photographed and supplied by Jequan Davis, 2026-11-20.
